fusions.name: Drifting Nudge
fusions.desc: A slow, heavy push that deals 12 damage, knocks the target 3 tiles back and leaves it [Bruised] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Unhurried End
fusions.desc: A thrown blow that deals 20 damage, hitting harder the further it travels, up to 1.5 times at maximum range. It only strikes a target at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Slow Mending
fusions.desc: Restores 16 health to you. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max +40%).

fusions.name: Soft Bulk
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once and heal you for 5% of your maximum health per stack (40% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
